ruleDefinitions.name: Conhost Spawned By Uncommon Parent Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when the Console Window Host (conhost.exe) process is spawned by an uncommon parent process, which could be indicative of potential code injection activity.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\smss\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\userinit\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wininit\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ apphost\\ \\-s\\ AppHostSvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ imgsvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ localService\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ RemoteRegistry.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ LocalSystemNetworkRestricted\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ NgcSvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ NetSvcs\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ NcaSvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ netsvcs\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ NetSetupSvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ netsvcs\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ wlidsvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ NetworkService\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ DoSvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ wsappx\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ AppXSvc.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ wsappx\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ ClipSVC.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-k\\ wusvcs\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ WaaSMedicSvc.*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Dropbox\\\\Client\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Dropbox\\\\Client\\\\.*")))
